Region Info Resource Get Region By Geo Coordinates
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/region/byGeoCoordinates

Retrieves the geographical data of the region or city that is located in the specified latitude and longitude coordinates. The geographical data includes the city name, state, country, geographical ID of the city and state, etc.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
latitude
double
REQUIRED

The latitude coordinate of the city or region

longitude
double
REQUIRED

The longitude coordinate of the city or region

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
cityGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the city

stateGeoId
int32

The geographical ID of the state

latitude
double

The latitude coordinate of the city

longitude
double

The longitude coordinate of the city

cityName
string

The name of the city

stateName
string

The name of the state, province, or territory of a country

countryName
string

The name of the country

countryCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter country code

postalCode
string

The postal code

continentCode
string

The ISO standard two-letter continent code
